name: Witch
overview: Scripture sternly condemns witchcraft and those who practice it, commanding that witches not be allowed to live (Exodus 22:18) and warning against seeking familiar spirits or wizards (Leviticus 19:31). God declares that those who turn to such occult practices will face severe judgment, including being cut off from their people or put to death (Leviticus 20:6, 20:27). The Lord calls His people to trust in Him alone rather than turning to those who claim to communicate with the dead or manipulate spiritual forces (Deuteronomy 18:10; Isaiah 8:19). This reveals God’s holiness and the serious danger of engaging with witchcraft, emphasizing reliance on Him as the living God.
